strict_errors: continuation carries dom.* events before any keyframe

expected_failures.first_dom_bearing_is_keyframe: first DOM-bearing segment 0 is not a keyframe
expected_failures.references_resolve: node 1, which the keyframe span never emitted

notes.defect: The recording opens with a continuation (initial_dom: null) that patches node 1. Spec §3: "the first DOM-bearing segment of a recording MUST be a keyframe."
notes.two_failures_one_defect: It fails references_resolve as well, and that is not sloppiness — it is the same defect seen from the other side. A continuation before any keyframe has no tree, so EVERY id it names is dangling. Declaring both is what stops a future reader from assuming the reference check is redundant here.
notes.why_it_is_catastrophic_rather_than_merel: The checkpoint executor refuses this shape explicitly (checkpoints.test.js's §3 self-test). CH's viewer renders it as a defect chip over an empty body, which is right for an analyst and fatal for an oracle: with nothing mounted, every `exists` reads false and every checkpoint asserting ABSENCE passes over a blank stage.
